<thought>Applying the retrosynthetic template (ID 614) to the target flavanone SMILES returned a single precursor SMILES. Since the reaction is intramolecular, the precursor set consists of just this one molecule. Therefore the list of possible precursor combinations is a list containing one inner list with that SMILES.</thought>
<final_answer>[["COc1ccc2c(c1)C1CCCC(C1)C(=O)C2"]]</final_answer>
